mainEntity.name: What is FAQ content writing for AEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: FAQ content writing for AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) involves creating structured questions and answers designed to be easily understood and directly pulled by search engines to answer user queries. This type of content aims to appear in rich snippets, featured snippets, and voice search results, directly providing concise answers to common questions. By anticipating user intent and providing clear, authoritative responses, AEO-optimized FAQs enhance visibility and drive relevant organic traffic to your website. It's about optimizing for direct answers, not just clicks.
